input.command: git status --porcelain=v1 -uall && echo "---BRANCH---" && git branch --show-current && echo "---VAR---" && ls -la var/ 2>/dev/null

cat .gitignore && echo "---TESTS---" && ls -R tests/ && echo "---SRC---" && ls -R src/ && echo "---DBTABLES---" && (sqlite3 var/local.db ".tables" 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('var/local.db');print(c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\").fetchall())")

file var/local.db; echo "---HEAD---"; head -c 400 var/local.db | cat -v; echo; echo "---ALLIGNORED---"; git status --ignored --porcelain=v1 -uall; echo "---ENV---"; ls -la .env 2>/dev/null || echo "no .env"
git clean -fdx && git reset --hard HEAD && rm -rf var/ && echo "---STATUS---" && git status --porcelain=v1 -uall --ignored
cp -a /tmp/inventory-reset-backup/.env .env && ls -la .env && echo "---CONFTEST---" && cat tests/conftest.py && echo "---PYPROJECT---" && cat pyproject.toml
